# Void Image Viewer

> Void Image Viewer is a free, lightweight, open-source (MIT) image viewer for Windows 10/11. It opens dozens of formats — including modern ones like WebP, AVIF, HEIC and JPEG XL — with no ads, no telemetry and no sign-up. voidimageviewer.com is an independent resource and download mirror for the open-source project, offering English and Simplified Chinese pages.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit; ARM/ARM64 portable builds available)
- License: MIT (open source, free forever)
- Latest version: 1.0.0.15
- Price: Free (0 USD)
- No ads, no telemetry, no account required
- Installer and portable ("green") builds available

## Primary pages (English)

- [Home](https://voidimageviewer.com/): Overview, features and download.
- [Download](https://voidimageviewer.com/download): All installer and portable builds for the latest version, plus previous versions.
- [Features](https://voidimageviewer.com/features): Full feature list.
- [Supported formats](https://voidimageviewer.com/supported-formats): Every supported image format with an in-browser preview tool.
- [Installation guide](https://voidimageviewer.com/installation): Install and set as default image viewer.
- [Release notes](https://voidimageviewer.com/release-notes): Full version history.
- [Screenshots](https://voidimageviewer.com/screenshots): Interface screenshots.
- [FAQ](https://voidimageviewer.com/faq): Common questions about download, install and usage.
- [About](https://voidimageviewer.com/about): Project background and disclaimer.

## Supported formats

PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, WebP, AVIF, HEIC/HEIF, SVG, ICO, JPEG XL (JXL), and common camera RAW files.

## Notes

- This site is an independent mirror and is not affiliated with the original authors.
- Binaries are verified against the official GitHub release checksums before publishing.
- Canonical domain: https://voidimageviewer.com
